name: GuoChuang Software Co.,Ltd.
summary: GuoChuang Software Co.,Ltd. engages in AI + Quantum high-tech software business in China and internationally. It offers digital industry software; industry intelligent agents for telecom operators and government and enterprise clients; and intelligent BMS, PACK, BEMS, energy storage systems, and High-Reliability software. The company also provides intelligent ETC and digital logistics supply chain management to cargo owners, logistics companies, and truck drivers. GuoChuang Software Co.,Ltd. was founded in 2000 and is based in Hefei, China.
